remarks: Welcome to this charming 2 bedroom, 1 bath ranch-style patio home offering effortless one-level living. The spacious living room features a gas fireplace and dining area, creating a warm and welcoming space to relax or entertain. The kitchen offers ample cupboard space and a cozy dining area, perfect for casual meals and your morning coffee. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet, while first floor laundry adds everyday ease. A full basement provides excellent storage or future finishing potential, and the attached two-car garage offers convenience. Enjoy worry-free lawn care and snow removal, provided by the HOA. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Updates include furnace and central air (2022) and HWT (2016). This home is ready to make everyday living feel easy and enjoyable. Don't miss the opportunity to make it your own!
